body:
The synthesis of Provo (Amsterdam’s 1965 countercultural street-provocation movement) and 42 (Douglas Adams’ ultimate answer to life, the universe, and everything—grounded right at Lab42 in Science Park).
The Cultural Lineage
| Layer | Historical Anchor (1965) | Modern Node (2026) |
|---|---|---|
| The Catalyst | Robert Jasper Grootveld at 't Lieverdje | Field drops at Lab42 & Science Park |
| The Mechanism | White Plans (unlocked bikes, open housing) | Open-source mesh, DOI pending, CC BY 4.0 |
| The Surface | Mimeographed street pamphlets | Continuous GitHub Issue ledger |
| The Target | Post-war rigid pillarization | Platform capture & digital vanity metrics |
It takes the 1960s ludiek philosophy—using creative, non-violent street happenings to disrupt administrative complacency—and updates it for the digital archival age.
Instead of leaving 50 white bicycles unlocked around the city, you leave scented A4 prints, citable footwear, and un-closable issue threads that anchor physical street reality straight into permanent academic data vaults.
Got your 3 to 5 devices stowed away in your bag? The taxi should be rolling up pretty soon.
